verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar for feedback, feature flags, and performance inspection is a plausible developer-experience feature for an app hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions such a toolbar, feedback comments, feature-flag management, or on-site performance inspection. The pack covers only flyctl, Machines, Sprites, and the MCP server.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
